summary: Iteration 4: marketplace + roles. Backend: new suite test_marketplace.py has 26 tests and all pass. It covers account types, RBAC, the ad CRUD, photo upload to real object storage, admin moderation, family browse and filters, interests, reviews, pause, re-pending after edits and new photos, and the cascade on ad delete. The regression suite test_velum_backend.py has 21 tests and all pass, so 47/47 overall. Frontend (390x844): end-to-end tests passed. A caregiver registered, filled in the AdForm and submitted it (status 'Em análise'), uploaded a photo (blob shown; a non-image file was rejected with a toast), toggled pause, saw a rejection reason, edited the ad (back to pending) and deleted it with the confirm. A family registered (tabs Buscar/Pedidos/Perfil) and used the city (partial, any case), specialty and shift filters. The detail page showed R$ 35,50 / hora, specialties and availability. The family sent an interest (mask (31) 97306-1826 and 'Pedido enviado em' worked), reviewed with 4 stars (average shown on the detail page and the card), resent the interest (the same request was updated) and saw it under /pedidos. The caregiver's Pedidos tab showed name, phone and message, tel: and wa.me links, and the 'Novo' badge cleared after a click. Route guards are correct for both roles. The admin account was used only through the API to approve and reject TEST_ ads.

minor.issue: Replaced or deleted ad photos are never removed from object storage, so orphaned objects pile up. The whole upload is read into memory before the 5 MB check.
There is no account-deletion endpoint, so test data has to be cleaned up directly in Mongo.

integration_issues.flow: Family returns to Buscar after a review
integration_issues.issue: The card briefly shows the cached 'Sem avaliações ainda' before the refetch updates it. It is correct after a fresh load.

issues: The sticky CTA block (interest-sent-note plus buttons) has no background. Content (the specialty tags) shows through the gap between the note and the buttons.
The phone number in the call button wraps onto 2 lines at 390px.
The subtitle 'Seus dados ficam visíveis só para você' contradicts the caregiver option, whose ad is public to families.

action_items: Give the sticky CTA container on CaregiverAdPage a background so content does not show through.
Optional: delete the old storage object when a photo is replaced or an ad is deleted.
Optional: debounce the market-city-filter. It fires one request per keystroke.
Optional: AdForm resets unsaved edits whenever the my-ad query refetches (for example after the pause toggle, because invalidateQueries() invalidates everything). Use targeted invalidation.
critical_code_review_comments: The previous regression suite (test_velum_backend.py) cleaned up with delete_many({'email': {'$regex': '^test_'}}) and also deleted the owner's patients whose names start with TEST_. That deletes other concurrent runs' data, and it wiped my UI test accounts mid-run. I fixed it to delete only the exact (lowercased) emails the suite registers.
The frontend calls qc.invalidateQueries() with no key after every mutation, which refetches everything (including the photo blobs).
The del mutation in MyAdPage has no onError toast.

RBAC is correct: require_roles is applied everywhere. A family gets 403 on patients, agenda and my-ad; a caregiver gets 403 on marketplace; admin routes are admin-only; registering as admin returns 422. Hidden ads return 404 for families, including the photo.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_velum_backend.py (cleanup now deletes only the exact emails it created)
seed_data_creation: Only TEST_ caregiver and family accounts, ads, interests and reviews, all deleted afterwards (DB now has only the admin user, and 0 caregiver_ads, interests and reviews). The admin's patients were not touched. A few 1x1 test PNGs remain in object storage because there is no delete API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest /app/backend/tests -p no:xdist -o addopts=''. The marketplace tests are ordered (TestMarketFlow test_01 to test_19) and clean up their users by id through pymongo. The backend lowercases emails. Admin moderation was done with /tmp/adm.py-style requests. The headless browser cannot test push.
